bounded_audit.status: generic-subspace-tracker comparison on explicit ambient drift; non-reproduction
bounded_audit.purpose: Test whether the benefit in the explicit ambient-rotation control is specific to Oja tracking or is a broader consequence of adaptive low-dimensional subspace estimation.

design.generic_tracker: exponentially weighted covariance PCA with Procrustes-aligned basis updates every 20 steps
design.generic_beta_tuning: beta selected from 0.001,0.003,0.01,0.03,0.1 on separate tuning seeds

bounded_audit.interpretation: Adaptive subspace tracking remains effective under genuine ambient drift, but this bounded control does not show an Oja-specific advantage. At 20 degrees both trackers are essentially tied; at 40 degrees MSE is tied while generic EW-PCA has lower subspace angle; at 80 degrees generic EW-PCA has both lower MSE and substantially lower angle. The strongest transferable mechanism supported here is therefore adaptive low-dimensional subspace tracking, not the particular Oja update.
limits: Synthetic observation model, not the authors' recurrent network or exact S8/S11/S12 implementation.
Generic EW-PCA uses a covariance matrix and eigendecomposition, so it is not biologically local and is only a computational mechanism control.
Hyperparameters were tuned for the generic tracker on separate synthetic seeds; no claim of paper-level superiority.
Do not generalize numeric effect sizes outside this bounded ambient-drift control.

candidate_update.positive_scope: Tracking a genuinely drifting ambient low-dimensional representation can materially reduce decoder error versus a frozen basis.
candidate_update.qualification: A generic adaptive PCA tracker matches or exceeds Oja in this explicit ambient-drift control, so Oja-specific computational benefit is not established.

exact_next_action: Prioritize read-only S1 Code recovery and source-exact S8/S11/S12 inspection. If still blocked, extend only the explicit ambient-drift non-reproduction with drift-rate and observation-noise sweeps plus a full-space regularized/RLS control to identify when low-dimensional tracking gives a conditioning or sample-efficiency advantage over generic full-space adaptation.
